acceptanceCriteria: Decide and record: keep the empty-output digest (documented in DCW-V0-047) or record NOT_PRODUCED with the base refusal code; the dogfood-check output and spec agree.
body: Source: V1-1276 builder report and docs/build-log/2026-10-12-v1-1276-dogfood-producer-cem-1-0.md 'Limits and NOT_RUN' (PR beamfall/corvint#837, merge 9deae4838). Decision 0525: RC3 ships cem/1.0 only; V1-1278 removes the 0.x readers, so each surface below must read cem/1.0 before or with that removal. Under an admitted DCW-V0-047 declaration the base verifier refuses the stable read, so dogfood-check records the base verifier digest as the digest of empty output (V1-1276 live qualification). Question: should the evidence record NOT_PRODUCED with the base refusal code instead of an empty-output digest, so a reader cannot mistake it for a successful empty read?
title: Question: DCW-V0-047 base verifier digest is the digest of empty output for a cem/1.0 map
